title: Ask your utility about the low-income discount rate

confirmations.question: Eligibility comes from enrollment in Fuel Assistance (HEAP), SNAP, MassHealth or a similar program. Is the household enrolled in one?
confirmations.nextAction: Call the Massachusetts Heat Line at 1-800-632-8175 or your utility.

sources.quote: If you qualify for Fuel Assistance/HEAP or another income-verified program from the list below, you will be referred to your local natural gas or electric utility for a discount on your utility bills.
Discounted rates that lower actual charges for your energy usage may be available.
